title: Sentinel-6 CPOD Combined Orbit Solution (AUX_COMB)
description: Contains the combined orbit solution obtained from a weighted mean of the most precise orbit solutions computed by each centre of the CPOD Quality Working Group (QWG), generated in SP3d format with one-day coverage and expressed in ITRF20. The combined solution is considered the most accurate orbit solution available within the CPOD QWG and is routinely taken as the reference to perform the quality control of all POD operational products.
